d:
From a luxury cruise in Halong Bay to the lights, crowds, and chaos of Hanoi—our Vietnam journey ends with one more evening of exploring!
In this final episode of our Vietnam series, Anu and I say goodbye to our two-night, three-day Halong Bay cruise and make our way back to Hanoi. After spending time surrounded by limestone islands and peaceful water, returning to the busy city feels like a completely different side of Vietnam.
